ui.title: Car insurance price
ui.subtitle: Enter your registration number and personnummer to get your yearly premium.
ui.crashes: Crashes you caused in the last 5 years (optional, only if you are new to us)
ui.gdpr: We use your personnummer only to calculate this price. It is not stored or logged.
ui.title_referred: We need to look at this personally
ui.title_declined: We can't give you a price right now
ui.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
reason.invalid_pnr: We could not recognise that as a valid Swedish personnummer. Please check the number (10 or 12 digits). If you have an identity number from another Nordic country, please contact us.
reason.coordination: You have a samordningsnummer. To be sure who you are, we need to handle your application personally. Please contact us and we will help you.
reason.foreign_id: That looks like an identity number from another Nordic country. We insure Swedish cars for people with a Swedish personnummer, so please contact us and we will help you.
reason.too_young: You must be at least 18 years old to buy car insurance from us.
reason.invalid_reg: That does not look like a Swedish registration number. It should look like ABC123 or ABC12D.
reason.car_not_found: We could not find that car in our vehicle data. Please check the registration number or contact us and we will look at it manually.
reason.already_insured: This car is already insured with you at Nordisk Bilförsäkring, so no new price is needed. Contact us if you want to change your policy.
reason.too_high_risk: Because of your crash history we cannot give you an automatic price. Please contact us for a manual review and we will see what we can do.
reason.price_ceiling: For this combination of driver and car the price would be higher than we can offer automatically. Please contact us for a manual review.
line.base: Base premium for a standard driver and car
line.history_none: No crash history known, standard assumption used
